summary: Not as a dip-buying signal. On BTC, ETH and SOL, buying while RSI was below 30, or as it crossed back up through 30, did no better than buying on a random candle. The result that holds up runs the other way: after RSI(14) went above 70, price kept rising more often than after a random candle.

verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily candles, with RSI(7) or RSI(14), as a level or as a cross back up through 30.
Worse than random on 1h, 4h and daily. Price kept rising after overbought readings, and the result holds without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles.
Beat random entries on 4h and daily, but only because of the rally between Dec 25, 2020 and Mar 3, 2021. Without it, chance.

notes: Buying while RSI(14) was below 30 on 4h gave 1,861 entries in 299 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.26% behind random entries, inside the luck band. RSI(7), Gainium’s default length, enters about two and a half times as often and lands in the same place.

Shorting while RSI(14) was above 70 did 0.40% worse than random entries after 20 candles on 1h, 1.31% worse on 4h and 10% worse after 20 days on daily. On 1h and 4h it shows at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles and holds without its strongest stretch. Overbought readings marked strength that continued, not tops.

Going long while RSI(14) was above 50 beat random entries by 0.31% on 4h, but the gap comes from the run between Dec 25, 2020 and Mar 3, 2021. Treat RSI above 50 as a trend filter to test, not as an edge on its own.

Single stretches can fake a result. On 1h, RSI(14) crossing up through 30 looked worse than random, but only because of signals on Nov 7–9, 2022, during the FTX collapse, when every bounce failed. On 4h, the short on a cross down through 70 looked bad only because of SOL’s run from about $4 to $11 in February 2021.

For a long DCA bot, oversold timing adds nothing on these pairs, and the DCA orders and take profit do the work. Where RSI carries information is above 70: a short bot that opens on overbought readings is trading against the trend. Test RSI on your own pair before you rely on it.
